pages.text: Belladonna berries and the $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/flower_extracts)belladonna and jimsonweed extracts$(/l) add atropine. It has a similar profile to LSD, including block reach, but builds and fades based on its own dose.

pages.title: Strong Effects
pages.text: Watch for altered sound and color, view drift, and random movements. Very high atropine intensity can cause damage. Distillation greatly concentrates these in-game extracts.
